title: Evaluate Project/scheduling engine candidates
objective: Determine whether a Project/scheduling engine foundation can satisfy ConstructionOS construction-project workflow requirements behind the frozen Project adapter boundary with reproducible semantic, API, replay, and licensing/composition evidence.
acceptance_criteria: At least one representative construction schedule completes WBS, activities, calendars, dependencies and critical-path behavior deterministically.
Baseline and progress workflows are exercised with explicit assertions and reproducible expected outputs.
At least one delay scenario and one alternative sequencing scenario are reproduced and compared deterministically.
Resource/capacity behavior is evaluated to the degree required by the frozen requirements and limitations are explicit.
API and adapter conformance is demonstrated without leaking engine-native identifiers or state into canonical Construction Graph semantics.
Historical schedule state remains replayable across later revisions.
Exact-version licensing and composition constraints are documented, with legal questions clearly separated from factual evidence.
Results support a clear recommendation: proceed behind adapter, proceed with explicit constraints, reject/evaluate alternative, or require ACR/legal review.
Architecture v1.1 remains frozen and no protected architecture path is modified.
non_goals: No assumption that OpenProject is suitable merely because it is mature or feature-rich.
No implementation-agent approval or verification claim.
risk_assumptions: CAD-PARITY-020/P020 is formally VERIFIED and establishes the CAD/BIM professional-complete milestone.
Construction Graph remains authoritative for shared project/domain identity.
Project engine identifiers remain provenance only and are not canonical domain identity.
The candidate may be rejected or constrained if deterministic behavior, replacement feasibility, or licensing/composition evidence is insufficient.
Architecture v1.1 remains active and frozen.
evidence_requirements: Exact candidate versions/builds and runtime environment.
API/adapter and Construction Graph identity/lineage evidence.
Exact-version licensing/composition evidence with unresolved legal questions identified.
Governed PR and revision-bound Architect verification evidence.

transitions.reason: CAD-PARITY-020 is formally VERIFIED, clearing the roadmap sequencing gate for Project/scheduling feasibility research.
Authorize z-ai-implementation-agent to execute the Project/scheduling feasibility research from the verified mainline, stopping at PR_OPEN/VERIFYING.
